patterns.note: Full-bleed, complex 3D renders are used as hero and interstitial section visuals, dominating the screen with surreal, high-fidelity imagery.
A high-contrast dark theme is established with a black background, white text, and vibrant neon green used exclusively for interactive elements and key accents.
Headings utilize an extremely bold, wide sans-serif typeface, creating a strong, impactful visual hierarchy against the dark background.
Sections reveal with a subtle fade-in and slight upward slide as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic scroll experience.
The hero section features a subtle parallax effect on its intricate 3D render as the user scrolls, adding depth to the initial view.
A large, stylized version of the studio's name (1:30 STUDIO) is fixed to the bottom of the viewport, gradually revealing itself as the user scrolls down to the footer, acting as a background element.
An 'Expertise' section uses a horizontal tabbed interface to categorize and display different service offerings, each with a distinct visual example.

technique_notes: The site employs scroll-triggered animations, likely using GSAP or a similar library, to reveal content sections with a staggered fade-up effect as they become visible in the viewport.
The hero features a complex, high-fidelity 3D render, likely implemented with WebGL (e.g., Three.js or a canvas library), which subtly shifts or parallaxes in response to scroll depth.
A sticky navigation bar maintains its position at the top of the screen, providing consistent access to primary links.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, extremely bold sans-serif headings (~4-5x body) with smaller, often uppercase, supporting labels and legible body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle, consistent rounding on interactive elements like buttons, input fields, and cards.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, with generous vertical spacing between major content sections and a balanced density within content blocks.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its use of highly detailed, surreal 3D renders as hero and interstitial visuals, creating a unique, immersive, and artistic brand identity. This, combined with the high-contrast dark theme and vibrant neon green accents, elevates it beyond a typical agency site.
